summary: Implemented strict administrator-only advertising banner and public-media contracts plus in-memory CRUD, preview, lifecycle scheduling, placement publication filtering, localization fallback, deterministic ordering, optimistic concurrency, and media-in-use protection.

verification.command: npm.cmd run build --workspace packages/contracts; npm.cmd run typecheck --workspace apps/api; node --test --import tsx apps/api/tests/ads/service.test.ts
verification.notes: Contracts and API typecheck passed; five focused ads tests passed.

verification.command: npm.cmd run typecheck; npm.cmd run lint; npm.cmd test -- --runInBand; npm.cmd run build
verification.notes: Repository typecheck and lint passed; full suite passed 360 tests; production build succeeded.

verification.command: npm.cmd audit --audit-level=high; npm.cmd run api:inventory; npm.cmd run openapi:validate; npm.cmd run postman:validate; node agent_pack/scripts/audit_pack.mjs; git diff --check
verification.notes: Dependency audit reported 0 vulnerabilities; API inventory, OpenAPI, Postman, Agent Pack audit, and whitespace checks passed.

knownGaps: Banner/media operations remain an in-memory service boundary; persistent repository and HTTP route wiring are outside this atomic task's existing allowed runtime surface.
Public media uses explicit HTTPS metadata URLs; no production media seed or vendor credentials are inferred.
Live database/provider integration checks were not run because no isolated replica-set topology or credentials were available; local deterministic tests cover the contract.
